description: This file defines an abstract class 'DocumentObjectCollection' that serves as a base collection class for managing a list of 'DocumentObject's within the MigraDoc Document Object Model. It implements collection interfaces, cloning, deep copy, and visitor pattern methods, and manages parent-child relationships among the document objects.

classes.name: DocumentObjectCollection
classes.description: An abstract base class providing collection functionalities for collections of DocumentObject instances within the MigraDoc library. It supports deep copying, cloning, adding, removing, enumeration, and visitor pattern acceptance, along with parent-child relationship management.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this DocumentObjectCollection.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the collection, cloning each DocumentObject and setting its parent to the new collection.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the collection elements into a specified array starting at a given index.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the collection and resets cached values.

methods.name: InsertObject
methods.description: Inserts a DocumentObject at a specific index and sets its parent, updating cached row values if applicable.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a specific DocumentObject in the collection.

methods.name: this[]
methods.description: Getter/setter for accessing elements at a specific index.

methods.name: LastObject
methods.description: Retrieves the last DocumentObject in the collection.

methods.name: RemoveObjectAt
methods.description: Removes a DocumentObject at a specified index and updates cached values.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a DocumentObject to the collection and sets its parent.

methods.name: AcceptVisitor
methods.description: Facilitates visitor pattern traversal over the collection and its elements.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks whether any element in the collection is non-null.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Clears the collection, setting all elements to null.
